description: This file defines the 'CheckoutScreen' widget for a Flutter app, managing the checkout process including order placement, UI presentation of delivery, payment, and order summary details, and navigation upon successful order placement.

classes.name: CheckoutScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget representing the checkout page with order confirmation, payment, and delivery details.

classes.name: _CheckoutScreenState
classes.description: State class managing the checkout page's dynamic behavior, including order placement, UI updates, and navigation.

methods.name: _placeOrder
methods.description: Asynchronously places an order via ApiService, updates the application's state, and navigates to the order tracking screen upon success. Handles UI state and error notifications.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the checkout screen, including delivery address, payment info, summary, and a button to confirm the order.

methods.name: _row
methods.description: Helper widget to display a label and value row for order summary details.
